rejected_claims_in_036: --run-full-comparison flag was never called; main only ran run_metadata_comparison, omitting actual H5 array processing.
match_uid_episodes used unauthorized proximity gate abs(dt) <= 0.010 s and invented 2*dt flutter bands.
Dense excess counts were prematurely asserted to prove matched entry/exit flutter pairs.
Identical aggregate destination mass was falsely equated to identical per-UID fates.
Blanket 'bitwise physics equality' claims were made solely based on equal mass reports.
remediations_enforced_in_v2: Worker main --binding --output executes full H5 array comparison and guard checks directly.
Complete elimination of proximity gates (abs(dt) <= tolerance) and tolerance bands.
Strict saved-bracket overlap matching: candidate association requires actual bracket intersection [t_start, t_end].
Ambiguous multi-overlap clusters (1-to-many, many-to-one, many-to-many) are strictly classified as AMBIGUOUS and reported separately.
Only proven unique 1:1 isolated components are classified as joint matches.
Unmatched dense events are objectively reported as extra_dense without unproven physical flutter labels.
Explicit per-UID fate switch tracking: computes fate switch mask, switched UID count, switched mass, and 5x5 transition matrix.
Clear scientific declaration: equal aggregate inventory does NOT establish identical per-UID fates.

Single-copy NVMe protected floor protocol: requires >= 100 GiB free space on NVMe scratch parent; verified_copy with SHA verification before scan; immediate removal on exit; zero 60 GiB trajectory copied.
